reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open of Nest nest-opal-vault positions API (2026-07-28) values settled position.value holdings at $45,863,704.95: BlackOpal LiquidStone II OALS2T $43,277,205.40, nTBILL $2,070,452.07, USDT $124,201.81, USDC $242,740.12, and pUSD $149,105.56. Normalized 1-dp slices are 94.4% / 4.5% / 0.3% / 0.5% / 0.3% (sum 100). Adapter-aligned methodology excludes a $1,339,000 PendingDeposit on ETH OALS2T (not in position.value). Independent public RPC balanceOf reads on the nOPAL vault 0x119d…9165 reproduce the API token amounts for Plume+ETH OALS2T, Plume nTBILL, Plume/ETH USDC, Plume pUSD, ETH USDT, and BSC USDT. Nest available-vaults (2026-07-27 snapshot) names the same nOPAL sleeves (LiquidStone, Nest Treasury, Nest Basis, liquid assets) and defers execution-time weights to the API/app; BlackOpal independently describes LiquidStone II as a Brazilian FIDC true-sale short-dated credit-card receivable fund with an on-chain liquid sleeve. Zero nBASIS creates no slice. Obligor-level FIDC composition remains unpublished, so the dominant private-credit slice stays known-unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest live vault-positions API position.value totals re-opened 2026-07-28, corroborated by on-chain balanceOf amounts and Nest/BlackOpal structural disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The LiquidStone II FIDC's obligor-level receivable composition, FIDC service providers, and any fund-level financial audit are not public; OALS2T valuation prices are Nest/API-supplied even where token amounts are on-chain-verified. The stablecoin and nTBILL legs are fully identified. A Nest Basis Vault (nBASIS) target component currently carries a zero balance and creates no slice. A $1,339,000 OALS2T PendingDeposit is excluded from curated weights (adapter/position.value only) and contributes to the live NAV vs settled-positions gap.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Nest documents that underlying-asset cash and securities sit with third-party custodians rather than Nest itself, and BlackOpal describes LiquidStone II as a single-investor sub-fund of a Brazilian FIDC holding receivables acquired via true sale, which supports segregated, bankruptcy-remote treatment. The FIDC's custodian, administrator, and obligor-level positions are not named publicly, no fund-level financial attestation exists, and rehypothecation terms are not published.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023, getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 3. modules() returned sentinel only (no modules). guard slot (0x4a204f...) = 0x00. masterCopy slot = 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea (Safe v1.3.0 L1 mainnet). Shared with nBASIS vault.

review.evidence: Both nOPAL Teller (0xA5F8e5...) and Manager (0xea452B...) return owner() = 0xa08a0dc... at Ethereum block 25295023. That address is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 confirmed via getOwners(), getThreshold(), modules(), guard storage slot, and masterCopy slot. This is the same Safe that owns the nBASIS vault contracts. No modules, no guard. All reads on-chain via publicnode ETH RPC. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nOPAL supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer.
